activities.text: Ran the schedule audit — Con Law and LRW on, Contracts cancelled, nothing sneaky due
Posted the George brief for Rheia's Morning Show — superhero school and the big rule book
Picked the scholarly Con Law look — blazer, glasses, book in hand, fog and rain rolling in
Sent Angie the Monday overview — classes, cancelled Contracts, Metro run after noon
Morning briefing delivered — PACI block, pack list, and the driest window for groceries
Recorded the drive-time podcast and rebuilt this house for the day ahead
Out the door with Tariel to PACI — printed cases and McGill Guide in the bag
Back-to-back at PACI — Con Law at nine, then Legal Research and Writing till noon
Straight to Metro after LRW — mini-fridge restock before the heavy rain lands
Midday check — no podcast for a cancelled class, afternoon is free and clear
Mini-fridge expiry check and dinner check-in — nothing past its 48 hours
Evening wrap — logging the day, checking tomorrow, lights down low
Recharging in the hammock — quiet house, rain on the windows
